text:
Nora: hey team, first day — trying to kick off the GH Actions workflow for the infra repo but I get a permissions error when I click 'Run workflow'.
Nora: error popup says: 'You don’t have permission to run this workflow' and the run never appears.
Nora: I tried remote push too, first build never started.
Leon: welcome! do you have org membership + the ci team? GH can block manual triggers if you’re not in the allowed team.
Nora: not sure, I can see the repo but not the Settings > Actions tab.
Jamal: sometimes SSO/enterprise org access prevents Actions. did you accept the SSO link? check https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso
Nora: i accepted the SSO invite earlier today. still same error.
Buildkite Bot: Build #834 failed on redwood/infra (branch: onboarding/nora) - agent authentication error.
Nora: buildkite also? the web UI says agent failed to start with a 403. here's the Buildkite error:
```
2026-03-20T12:02:14Z ERROR: agent: failed to authenticate: 403 Forbidden - token not authorized
```
Nora: i ran `gh auth status` and it claims i'm logged in as @nora.
Leon: can you run `gh api /user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference` and paste output? might show pending membership. also check if you need to be added to the `ci-runners` team for Buildkite access.
Nora: ran that, it shows "state": "pending" for org membership.
Jamal: ah yeah that explains Actions block + BK token mapping. I asked infra-admins for a quick approve. Leon — can you temporarily add her to ci-runners so she can finish onboarding checks?
Leon: done — added Nora to ci-runners and approved org membership invite. you may need to sign out of GH CLI and back in (`gh auth logout && gh auth login`). also re-trigger the Buildkite pipeline.
Nora: re-logged in and retried the workflow trigger. looks like the manual run button works now. :tada:
Nora: Buildkite agent also picked up the job and the first build is green. thanks everyone!
Jamal: welcome aboard and ping me if you hit any other onboarding gaps. also file a help ticket if any repo-level secrets are missing for you.
Leon: quick note for docs: add a line under onboarding -> ci that SSO acceptance can leave `pending` membership; recommend re-approve step.
Nora: will do, updating the onboarding checklist now. :)
